text: 据中国外交部网站，2026年10月10日，中共中央政治局委员、中央外办主任王毅在大同与法国总统外事顾问博纳举行第二十八次中法战略对话，就深化中法战略合作长时间深入沟通，达成广泛共识。双方还肯定了中欧贸易投资磋商机制取得的积极成果。
text_en: According to the website of China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs, on October 10, 2026, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Director of the Office of the Central Commission for Foreign Affairs, held the 28th China-France Strategic Dialogue with Emmanuel Bonne, Diplomatic Advisor to the French President, in Datong, engaging in lengthy and in-depth communication on deepening China-France strategic cooperation and reaching broad consensus. The two sides also affirmed the positive results achieved by the China-EU trade and investment consultation mechanism.
